capabilities.note: Added by an earlier change, and it is the one competence of the eight the System One overlay proposes that nothing here already covers. `evolution.evaluation` runs the suite and `evolution.anti_goodhart` asks whether the gain is real; neither asks whether a 0.8 happens four times in five. A design decision and the addendum's Gap 2 are why that is a separate question: a model's probability is not an epistemic confidence, and this repository has a knowledge store where the difference is load-bearing.
